scenes.motion_prompt: The same 2D illustrated character Bobo, wearing a headband, quickly pumps the dumbbells up and down doing fast bicep curls, sweat drops flicking off with each rep, cheeks puffing with effort, brow furrowed in strain, breathing hard. After a few fast reps his arms suddenly give out mid-curl, he loses his balance and comically topples backward, flopping flat onto the yoga mat with the dumbbells dropping and rolling beside him. He lies there sprawled and defeated, chest heaving, with a tired, unimpressed deadpan expression. The desk lamp and monitor glow flicker faintly, city lights twinkle outside the window. Cozy late-night comedic energy, smooth continuous motion, no glitches, consistent character and art style.
